description: In front of you on the green bedsheet are several piles of colorful beads, a black tape dispenser, and a cord with some yellow beads already strung. The left hand steadies the cord near the partly strung section while the right hand reaches to the yellow/orange bead pile, pinches a single bead, brings it over to the cord end, and uses both hands together to guide the cord through the bead so it can slide onto the strand.
